name: QDLR-NeRF
aliases: Light Field Compression via Compact Neural Scene Representation
Quantized Distilled Low Rank Neural Radiance Field
definition: A neural radiance field representation optimized for light field compression by sequentially applying low-rank constraints, network distillation, and quantization to reduce model size while maintaining reconstruction quality.
summary: QDLR-NeRF is a light field compression method that reduces NeRF model size to 3.3% via low-rank constraints, tensor train decomposition, and global codebook quantization.
